# Nehemiah Chapter 11 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A), Folios 472v–473r | **Source Image:** source-texts/hebrew-OT/NEH_011_page_001.jpg

---

**11:1** And-the-leaders [sarey] of-the-people dwelt [va-yeshvu] in-Yerushalayim, and-the-rest of-the-people cast lots [hippilu goralot] to-bring one of-ten [mi-asarah] to-dwell in-Yerushalayim the-holy city [ir ha-qodesh], and-nine parts [yadot] in-the-[other] cities.

**11:2** And-the-people blessed [va-yevarkhu] all the-men who-volunteered [ha-mitnaddevim] to-dwell in-Yerushalayim.

**11:3** And-these [are] the-heads of-the-province [ha-medinah] who-dwelt in-Yerushalayim — and-in-the-cities of-Yehudah each dwelt in-his-possession [achuzzato] in-their-cities: Yisra'el, the-priests, the-Levi'im, the-Netinim, and-the-sons of-the-servants of-Shelomoh.

**11:4** And-in-Yerushalayim dwelt from the-sons of-Yehudah and-from the-sons of-Binyamin. From the-sons of-Yehudah: Atayah son of-Uzziyyah son of-Zekharyah son of-Amaryah son of-Shefatyah son of-Mahalal'el, from the-sons of-Perets.

**11:5** And-Ma'aseyah son of-Barukh son of-Kol-Chozeh son of-Chazayah son of-Adayah son of-Yoyariv son of-Zekharyah son of-ha-Sheloni.

**11:6** All the-sons of-Perets who-dwelt in-Yerushalayim: four-hundred sixty-eight [468] men of-valor [anshey chayil].

**11:7** And-these [are] the-sons of-Binyamin: Sallu son of-Meshullam son of-Yo'ed son of-Pedayah son of-Qolayah son of-Ma'aseyah son of-Iti'el son of-Yesha'yah.

**11:8** And-after-him Gabbay, Sallay: nine-hundred twenty-eight [928].

**11:9** And-Yo'el son of-Zikhri [was] overseer [paqid] over-them, and-Yehudah son of-ha-Senu'ah [was] over the-city second [al ha-ir mishneh].

**11:10** From the-priests: Yedayah son of-Yoyariv, Yakhin, **11:11** Serayah son of-Chilqiyyah son of-Meshullam son of-Tsadoq son of-Merayot son of-Achituv, the-ruler [nagid] of-the-house of-God.

**11:12** And-their-brothers who-did the-work of-the-house: eight-hundred twenty-two [822]. And-Adayah son of-Yerocham son of-Pelalyah son of-Amtsi son of-Zekharyah son of-Pashchur son of-Malkiyyah,

**11:13** and-his-brothers, heads of-fathers: two-hundred forty-two [242]. And-Amashsay son of-Azar'el son of-Achzay son of-Meshillemot son of-Immer,

**11:14** and-their-brothers, mighty-men of-valor [gibborey chayil]: a-hundred twenty-eight [128]. And-the-overseer over-them [was] Zavdi'el son of-ha-Gedolim.

**11:15** And-from the-Levi'im: Shemayah son of-Chashshuv son of-Azriqam son of-Chashavyah son of-Bunni.

**11:16** And-Shabbetay and-Yozavad, from the-heads of-the-Levi'im, [were] over the-outside work [ha-melakhah ha-chitsonah] of-the-house of-God.

**11:17** And-Mattanyah son of-Mikha son of-Zavdi son of-Asaf [was] the-head [ha-rosh], the-beginning [tekhillah] of-the-thanksgiving [yodeh] in-prayer [la-tefillah], and-Baqbuqyah the-second [mishneh] among his-brothers, and-Avda son of-Shammua son of-Galal son of-Yedutun.

**11:18** All the-Levi'im in-the-holy city [ir ha-qodesh]: two-hundred eighty-four [284].

**11:19** And-the-gatekeepers: Aqqub, Talmon, and-their-brothers who-kept-watch [ha-shomerim] at-the-gates: a-hundred seventy-two [172].

**11:20** And-the-rest of-Yisra'el, the-priests, the-Levi'im, [were] in-all the-cities of-Yehudah, each in-his-inheritance [be-nachalato].

**11:21** And-the-Netinim dwelt in-the-Ofel, and-Tsicha and-Gishpa [were] over the-Netinim.

**11:22** And-the-overseer [paqid] of-the-Levi'im in-Yerushalayim [was] Uzzi son of-Bani son of-Chashavyah son of-Mattanyah son of-Mikha, from the-sons of-Asaf, the-singers, over the-work [melekhet] of-the-house of-God.

**11:23** For the-commandment of-the-king [mitsvat ha-melekh] [was] upon-them, and-a-fixed-provision [amanah] for-the-singers [was set] for-each-day's [dvar yom be-yomo] need.

**11:24** And-Petachyah son of-Meshezav'el, from the-sons of-Zerach son of-Yehudah, [was] at the-king's hand [le-yad ha-melekh] for-every matter [le-khol davar] concerning-the-people.

**11:25** And-for the-villages [chatserim] with-their-fields [sadoteyhem]: from the-sons of-Yehudah dwelt in-Qiryat-ha-Arba and-its-daughters [u-vi-venoteyha], and-in-Divon and-its-daughters, and-in-Yeqavtse'el and-its-villages,

**11:26** and-in-Yeshua, and-in-Moladah, and-in-Beyt-Pelet, **11:27** and-in-Chatsar-Shu'al, and-in-Be'er-Sheva and-its-daughters, **11:28** and-in-Tsiqlag, and-in-Mekhonah and-its-daughters, **11:29** and-in-Ein-Rimmon, and-in-Tsor'ah, and-in-Yarmut, **11:30** Zano'ach, Adullam, and-their-villages, Lakhish and-its-fields, Azeqah and-its-daughters. And-they-encamped [va-yachanu] from-Be'er-Sheva unto the-Valley of-Hinnom [Gey Hinnom].

**11:31** And-the-sons of-Binyamin from-Geva: Mikhmas, and-Ayyah, and-Beyt-El and-its-daughters, **11:32** Anatot, Nov, Ananyah, **11:33** Chatsor, Ramah, Gittayim, **11:34** Chadid, Tsevo'im, Nevallat, **11:35** Lod, and-Ono, the-Valley of-the-Craftsmen [Gey ha-Charashim].

**11:36** And-from the-Levi'im, divisions [machleqot] of-Yehudah [were assigned] to-Binyamin.

---

## EMET's Textual Notes
1. **11:1 "holy city"** — Jerusalem is called *ir ha-qodesh* (the holy city); this designation, used again in v. 18, is relatively rare in the Hebrew Bible and emphasizes the city's sacred status in the post-exilic period.
2. **11:1 "one of ten"** — A tithe of the population was chosen by lot to populate Jerusalem, while volunteers (v. 2) were publicly blessed — indicating that settling in the still-dangerous capital required sacrifice.
3. **11:23 "commandment of the king"** — The Persian crown supported the temple singers financially, showing the intersection of imperial patronage and Jewish worship.

*— EMET*
